gitsync.title: Project Git
gitsync.about: The project's server, updating and sending — by a button or automatically. If something fails, the section says why and offers a fix.
gitsync.load_failed: Could not read the project's Git status.
gitsync.not_saved: The Git setup is not saved yet: you see what git knows by itself. Automation starts after saving.
gitsync.mod_outdated: The «{name}» module is outdated: {have} installed, {kit} in the kit
gitsync.mod_why: Updating and sending work without the module. The module checks sign-in, rights and the repository through the server API and knows its URLs.
gitsync.sync_not_on_server: The branch is not on the server yet — the first send creates it
gitsync.never_fetched: The server was not asked yet — the numbers are from the last known data
gitsync.branch_hint: A branch is the project's line of history; the server has the same one
gitsync.push_hint: Commit what is uncommitted and send it to the server
gitsync.fetch_hint: Find out what is new on the server without changing the project
gitsync.commit_hint: Save the changes in the project history without sending
gitsync.failed_console: The action failed — details are in the «Console»
gitsync.strat.rebase: mine on top of the server's
gitsync.strat_hint.ff_only: The safest: updating happens only when you have no unsent commits of your own. Diverged — the section offers a way.
gitsync.strat_hint.merge: Your and the server's changes are joined by a merge commit; the history shows both lines.
gitsync.strat_hint.rebase: Your unsent commits are moved on top of the server's; the history stays straight.
gitsync.conflicts_about: You and the server changed the same places. For each file choose whose version is right, or fix it yourself and mark «Done». Then finish the update — or cancel it, and the project returns to how it was before.
gitsync.conflicts_none_left: All files are resolved — you can finish.
gitsync.mine_hint: The file becomes what you had before the update
gitsync.theirs_hint: The file becomes what came from the server
gitsync.resolved_hint: You fixed the file yourself: the <<<<<<< and >>>>>>> marks are removed
gitsync.auto_about: Works while the panel runs. Each run's result is in the journal below and in the «Console»; a failure marks the «Git» menu item until the next run succeeds. While a route or a command runs in the project, automation leaves it alone.
gitsync.auto_needs_setup: To switch automation on, complete the setup
gitsync.on.open: when the project is opened in the panel
gitsync.on.after_commit: after a commit — once commits stop for two minutes
gitsync.skipped.busy: postponed: work was running in the project — it runs once that ends
gitsync.ok.update_none: already up to date: nothing new on the server
gitsync.ok.update: taken from the server: {n} changes, {files} files touched
gitsync.ok.push_none: everything is already on the server
gitsync.field.strategy: How to update when you and the server diverged
gitsync.h.instance: Your own server — with the port if it is not standard. Can stay empty if the full repository URL is given below.
gitsync.h.repo: owner/name or a full URL: https://… or git@…
gitsync.h.remote: Usually origin; change only if the project has several servers
gitsync.auth.system: As set up in git on this machine
gitsync.h.auth.system: If git on this machine already reaches the server (keychain, password manager, ssh-agent), nothing has to be entered.
gitsync.h.auth.token: Safer than a password: a token has its own rights and expiry and can be revoked. Stored outside the project, in ~/.aurora, mode 600.
gitsync.h.auth.password: Stored outside the project, in ~/.aurora, mode 600; never written into the server URL.
gitsync.h.auth.ssh: A key without a passphrase or one added to ssh-agent. Empty — the default keys.
gitsync.h.user.token: Your login on the server — «Check connection» fills it in
gitsync.h.secret_keep: Saved. Leave empty to keep it
gitsync.h.token.gitea: Gitea: Settings → Applications → Generate token (repository: read and write)
gitsync.h.token.gitlab: GitLab: User settings → Access tokens (read_repository, write_repository, read_api)
gitsync.h.token.bitbucket: Bitbucket: Profile → HTTP access tokens (repository write)
gitsync.h.token.generic: Your server's token or app password
gitsync.h.ssh_key_text: Saved to ~/.aurora/git/keys with mode 600 — never into the project
gitsync.secret_set: saved — type a new one to replace
gitsync.step.api_off: — the provider module is not installed, the API check is skipped
gitsync.use_branch: The server's default branch is {branch}: use it
gitsync.repo_empty: The repository on the server is empty — the first send creates the branch.
gitsync.cert_about: Compare the fingerprint with the server administrator. Trust saves exactly this certificate: verification stays on, and a different certificate will not pass.
gitsync.cert_trusted: The certificate is saved; git and the connection check will trust it
gitsync.a.set_upstream: Link the branch to the server
gitsync.a.update_rebase: Put mine on top of the server's
gitsync.a.use_current_branch: Make the open one the project branch
gitsync.a.strip_url: Remove the password from the URL
gitsync.p.no_git: git is not installed on this machine
gitsync.fix.no_git: Install git — the «Install» page says how.
gitsync.p.no_repo: The project is not under git yet
gitsync.fix.no_repo: Create the repository: the history of changes starts from this minute.
gitsync.p.no_remote: No server is set for the project
gitsync.fix.no_remote: Give the repository address on the server in the setup.
gitsync.fix.bad_url: Check the address: https://server/owner/repository or git@server:owner/repository.
gitsync.p.detached: The project is not on a branch
gitsync.fix.detached: Switch to the project branch — otherwise new commits have nowhere to go.
gitsync.p.other_branch: Branch {current} is open, the setup says {wanted}
gitsync.fix.other_branch: Switch to the setup's branch or make the open one the project branch.
gitsync.p.auth: The server did not accept the sign-in
gitsync.fix.auth: Check the login and the token (or password): the token may have expired or lack rights to the repository.
gitsync.fix.forbidden: The sign-in is accepted but this action is not allowed: ask the repository owner for write access or choose another branch.
gitsync.p.ssh_key: The server did not accept the SSH key
gitsync.fix.ssh_key: Add the public part of the key to your profile on the server or give another key.
gitsync.p.ssh_hostkey: The server presented an unknown SSH key
gitsync.fix.ssh_hostkey: If the server was reinstalled, remove its old entry from ~/.ssh/known_hosts; if not, check the fingerprint with the administrator: it may be an impostor.
gitsync.p.ssh_passphrase: The SSH key has a passphrase
gitsync.fix.ssh_passphrase: Add the key to ssh-agent (ssh-add) or give a key without a passphrase.
gitsync.p.ssh_key_perms: The SSH key is readable by others
gitsync.fix.ssh_key_perms: ssh refuses such a key: restrict it to mode 600.
gitsync.fix.cert: If the server is yours and has its own certificate, trust it by fingerprint; otherwise check the server address.
gitsync.fix.network: Check the network, the VPN and the server address; retry later.
gitsync.p.repo_not_found: The repository was not found on the server
gitsync.fix.repo_not_found: Check the owner and the repository name. For a private repository this also means «no read access».
gitsync.p.remote_branch_missing: The server has no such branch
gitsync.fix.remote_branch_missing: Send the project — the branch appears on the server.
gitsync.p.no_upstream: The branch is not linked to the server
gitsync.fix.no_upstream: Link it so updating and sending know where to go. Sending links it by itself.
gitsync.p.rejected: The server has changes you do not have
gitsync.fix.rejected: Update the project first, then send.
gitsync.p.protected: The server does not accept sends to this branch
gitsync.fix.protected: The branch is protected by server rules: send to another branch or ask the owner for rights.
gitsync.p.diverged: Your and the server's changes diverged
gitsync.fix.diverged: The safe update (fast-forward only) is not possible: join the changes by merging or put yours on top of the server's.
gitsync.p.conflict: Changes overlap in the same places
gitsync.fix.conflict: For each file choose whose version is right or fix it yourself, then finish the update. You can also cancel it.
gitsync.p.conflict_markers: Conflict marks are left in the file
gitsync.fix.conflict_markers: Remove the <<<<<<<, ======= and >>>>>>> lines — or choose a whole version.
gitsync.fix.dirty: Commit them — the update goes on top.
gitsync.p.locked: Another program is using the project's git
gitsync.fix.locked: Wait and retry; if nobody is working, close the editor or terminal running git.
gitsync.p.busy: A Git action is already running in the project
gitsync.p.ratchet: The ratchet stopped the commit: the changes add new base errors
gitsync.fix.ratchet: Fix the errors (kb:lint) or commit anyway — your call.
gitsync.p.msg_hook: The commit message has an internal name
gitsync.fix.msg_hook: Rewrite the message template: internal names do not go into history.
gitsync.p.unrelated: The server's history is unrelated to the project's
gitsync.fix.unrelated: Probably a different repository. Check the address; create a new repository empty, without a README.
gitsync.p.creds_in_url: A password is written in the server URL
gitsync.fix.creds_in_url: It lies in plain text in .git/config. Move it to the protected store.
gitsync.p.no_commits: The project has no commits yet
gitsync.fix.no_commits: Commit the changes — then there is something to send.
gitsync.fix.module_missing: Updating and sending work without it; the sign-in and rights check via API comes after installing.
gitsync.fix.module_outdated: The kit has a newer version — update the module.
gitsync.fix.settings: Open the setup: the wrong fields are highlighted.
gitsync.fix.unknown: Details are below, in the git output.
gitsync.f.url: the address must start with http:// or https://
gitsync.f.repo: owner/name or a full URL https://… or git@…
gitsync.f.name: Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore
gitsync.f.branch: a branch cannot be named so: no spaces, «..», «~^:?*[
gitsync.f.email: does not look like an email address
gitsync.f.placeholder: the template has an unknown placeholder
gitsync.f.every: not more often than every 5 minutes
gitsync.f.creds_in_url: a password is not kept in the URL — it was removed; enter it under «Sign-in»
gitsync.f.key_format: this is not a private key: it starts with -----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY-----
gitsync.f.required_for_token: the server needs a login with the token — «Check connection» fills it in
gitsync.f.no_repo: the project is not under git — create the repository first
gitsync.mirrors_about: Copies of the project on other servers — for example, your own Gitea next to the work GitLab or Bitbucket. Updating comes only from the main server; sending goes to the main one and to the additional ones marked «with the main». Each has its own address and sign-in.
gitsync.field.name: New name
gitsync.with_primary: Send together with the main server
gitsync.mirror_missing: git has no such server — save the setup
gitsync.mirror_new: the branch is not there yet
gitsync.demote_about: Server {remote} gets a new name (git remote rename) and becomes additional — with its address and sign-in; sending to it continues. The work server becomes the main one once you give it above.
gitsync.f.duplicate: this name is taken by another server
gitsync.h.token.github: GitHub: Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens (Contents: Read and write). The server address can stay empty for github.com
gitsync.q.title: Connect with a git clone line
gitsync.q.about: Copy the clone line from the repository page (the Clone button) and paste it here: the server, repository, branch and login fill in by themselves. Then pick the sign-in method and enter the password.
gitsync.q.err.no_url: The line has no repository address — paste it whole: git clone https://…
gitsync.q.err.bad_url: This does not look like a repository address: https://…, git@server:… or ssh://… is needed
gitsync.q.secret_moved: The password from the line went to the password field: it is not written into the server address.
gitsync.q.replace_main: The main server is already set — its address is replaced by this one.
gitsync.q.name_hint: The server name in git (git remote): Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen
gitsync.q.push_now: Push the project to this server
gitsync.q.dirty_ask: The setup below has unsaved edits — they will be dropped. Connect?
gitsync.h.bbcloud.password: On bitbucket.org the account password does not work for git — paste an API token here: avatar → Account settings → Security → Create and manage API tokens → Create API token with scopes → Bitbucket, scopes read:repository and write:repository. The token is shown once.
gitsync.h.bbcloud.user: The Bitbucket username, not the e-mail — as in the git clone line (Personal settings → Bitbucket profile). Case matters.
gitsync.h.bbcloud.token: bitbucket.org: a repository access token (Repository settings → Access tokens, Repositories: Read and Write) or an account API token. The login can stay empty.
gitsync.step.api_login: — the server API did not accept this sign-in but git did; the bitbucket.org API expects the Atlassian e-mail. It does not affect the project
gitsync.step.api_failed: — the server API did not answer ({reason}), but git reaches the repository: that is enough
gitsync.h.password: The password of your account on the server. If password sign-in is closed (e.g. by two-factor protection), pick «Access token».
